other_conditions: Applicant must be an indigenous inhabitant of Nagaland
Applicant must be pursuing B.Sc. (Horticulture), M.Sc. (Horticulture) or Ph.D. (Horticulture)
The institution where the applicant studies must be recognized by UGC
Applicant must not be receiving any other scholarship or stipend
benefits_summary: Scholarships/Stipends are provided for up to 4 years for B.Sc., 2 years for M.Sc., and 3 years for Ph.D. in horticulture.
